name: Orb · SHDR-26
description: A crazed web of coloured threads knotted to a cell grid: a nine-octave feedback warp carrying a lattice pole term, so the field flows through cell interiors and tears itself around every cell corner, banded by an exponential ridge function that draws a thin bright thread every PI over a lit floor. The per-channel phase is a large fraction of a thread that narrow, so each one separates into three coloured filaments running in parallel, and a fourth-power read of the same ridge lays a white-hot core inside them (WebGL). Ported from Orbkit shdr-26 — shader by XorDev, non-commercial.
